Claim 1 (Currently amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a __flexible__ seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of __at least 0.010 inches and less than 0.030 inches__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of __at least 0.010 inches and less than 0.030 inches__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the __flexible__ seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the __flexible__ seal.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the __flexible__ seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi.
